military_activity.instructions: What military activity does this report describe?

criteria.strike: Airstrikes, missile launches, shelling or armed attacks
criteria.deployment: Troop movements or operational deployment of forces
criteria.procurement: Weapons purchases, equipment deliveries or defence contracts
criteria.diplomacy: Defence negotiations, agreements or ceasefire talks
criteria.commentary: Opinion, analysis or predictions rather than a reported occurrence
criteria.unclear: Insufficient evidence or no matching military activity
